name: Will staining make my cabin interior look better without hiding the wood grain?

mainEntity.name: Will staining make my cabin interior look better without hiding the wood grain?

acceptedAnswer.text: A stained finish usually keeps the natural wood look better than paint and can highlight grain, knots, and character. It is a strong choice if you want warmth and texture, but it will also show existing imperfections more than an opaque finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Staining is usually chosen to enhance the natural wood grain rather than cover it, so it adds warmth while keeping the cabin’s original character visible.
